description: Followups, tasks, solutions and validations of a ticket, change or problem, merged into one chronological list (oldest first; order 'desc' for the latest first), with the people's names (user_name, tech_name, validator_name) and the solution type name. Replaces calling the four list tools separately and interleaving them by hand.

fields.description: Field set: 'essential' (default, trims internal GLPI fields) or 'all'

format.description: Output format: 'json' (default) or 'markdown' (a table for listings, key/value lines for one item; returned in both the text and the structured result)

order.description: asc (default) = oldest first, desc = latest first

range.description: Pagination range over the merged timeline, e.g. 0-24

name: glpi_list_timeline

format.description: 'markdown' when data holds the markdown rendering

note.description: Pagination hint: how to fetch the next page

title: List timeline
